title: Top Research Universities in Trinidad and Tobago
desc: Universities and colleges in Trinidad and Tobago ranked by the total citations their research has received (OpenAlex).

source.name: OpenAlex, citations received by each institution's papers
source.note: Counts every citation to papers by authors affiliated with the institution, so large and old universities score high. It measures research impact, not teaching quality.

items.name: College of Science, Technology and Applied Arts of Trinidad and Tobago
